apps.name: Chernobyl VR Project
apps.short_description: Visit Chernobyl without leaving home! Chernobyl VR Project is a unique project by The Farm 51, as it combines video games with educational and movie narrative software. It is the very first virtual tour around the Chernobyl and Pripyat area, compatible with VR headsets.

apps.name: DEMoCap (Drag[en]gine Motion Capture)
apps.short_description: DEMoCap allows to do Motion Capture using VR equipment for example for Game Development.

apps.name: ElectricWorks
apps.short_description: Draw an electrical circuit and watch it work. ElectricWorks simulates everything you wire, from a battery and a bulb to car electrics, home wiring and 3-phase motor starters, with real parts, real wire sizes and a 3D view where you can see the current flow.

apps.name: Fatiao Agent
apps.short_description: Fatiao is a plugin-based desktop AI agent. The core plans and orchestrates; voice, knowledge base, search, desktop control, automation and sub-agents are plugins you toggle. Plugins and skills come from the community Workshop — one click to subscribe. One app, a thousand faces. Windows and macOS.

apps.name: Interfuse
apps.short_description: Transform Twitch events into live game interactions. Build powerful automations for avatar parameters, Chatbox, sounds, avatar switching, SteamVR notifications and more—through an accessible visual editor.

apps.name: iTop Easy Desktop for Steam
apps.short_description: iTop Easy Desktop: a free and easy-to-use desktop manager and wallpaper tool for Windows.  Automatically organize icons, files, and folders. Create private boxes. Enjoy quick search access,  scheduling tools & more. Experience a clutter-free desktop and maximize productivity with this powerful App.

apps.name: Live Desktop
apps.short_description: CPU uses only 1% Live Wallpaper software！

apps.name: Mod Anything
apps.short_description: Make the mod you always wanted. Describe a change to a PC game you own, and an AI coding agent helps you research, build and test it. Create new mechanics, challenges and crossovers, then share your mods. Free desktop workspace; AI assistance uses paid credits.

apps.name: Pixel Painter
apps.short_description: Pixel Painter is a 3D texture painter made for pixel art. Paint crisp, pixel-perfect textures straight onto your models, layer procedural materials like stone, wood and vines, shape light and wear with smart masks, and export clean PBR maps for games and animation.

apps.name: Proximity Core
apps.short_description:
Proximity voice chat, waypoints, and positional music for many
games. No mods, servers, or complex setup.

apps.name: Scope X
apps.short_description: The #1 screen magnification overlay for competitive FPS players. Instantly zoom into any part of your screen to spot distant targets, reveal critical details, and gain a visual edge. Built for shooters.

apps.name: Simple Voice Changer — Soundboard & Mic Effect
apps.short_description: Change your voice live in Discord, games and streams. Load your own RVC voice model to sound like a character, pick one of 200 neural voices that run on your CPU, or use 10 classic effects, 30+ knobs, a soundboard and music. No account needed. Windows, SteamOS, Linux.

apps.name: Volume² - advanced Windows volume control
apps.short_description: Take full control of Windows sound. Change the volume with the mouse wheel, hotkeys or screen edges, set up each app and device your way, and choose from 44 on-screen display skins.

apps.name: VRTI - VR Treadmill Interface
apps.short_description: Walk, jog, and run in VR using your real treadmill. VRTI connects your Bluetooth treadmill to VRChat and other games, turning your workout into an adventure.

apps.name: Abysswalkers Playtest
apps.short_description: TCG Game

apps.name: Dala and The Cursed Forest Playtest
战术战斗系统 TCS Playtest
記憶力最強エレベーター！？ Playtest
developers: インフィニットクリエイト

apps.name: I Won't Let You Level Up In My Goblin Town Demo
apps.short_description:
You might not be the strongest goblin in town, but you are the fastest. When adventurers come to your town to grind EXP, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle.
Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any grinding adventurer.

apps.name: Aftergarden Demo
apps.short_description: Blast through enemy barrages in this 2D shooting RPG demo. Play Zone A and Zone B, collect weapons and Fragments, and upgrade your angel and allied formation in town. Break through outfit stages with the firepower you build.

apps.name: Allogloom Demo
apps.short_description:
Demo: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game.
Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

apps.name: ALONE: Mnemophobia Demo
apps.short_description: Play the prologue of ALONE: Mnemophobia. Face "The Presence" in a disturbing interrogation, survive the darkness that drains your sanity, and solve macabre puzzles in this psychological horror demo with a gritty VHS aesthetic.

apps.name: AMIDA Q Demo
apps.short_description: AMIDA Q is a high-difficulty amidakuji (ladder lottery) puzzle game. Place pieces to complete the ladder and guide the balls flowing in from the left to their lanes, in the specified order. New gimmicks keep appearing as you progress, making the ladder ever more complex. Dynamic and dramatic.

apps.name: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit Demo
apps.short_description: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

apps.name: At Sixes and Sevens Demo
apps.short_description:
A PSX Detective Mystery Horror game. You play as an investigator solving bizarre crime cases. 
The story unfolds through a blend of interviews, computer based investigations and unsettling psychological elements.

apps.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business - Demo
apps.short_description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

apps.name: Back To Drive Demo
apps.short_description: Back To Drive is a car assembly, driving, and survival simulator set in a cyberpunk world. Start with a rusty frame and turn it into a car where every part affects its performance. Customize it to your liking and embark on a journey through the wastelands. Work, race, and explore the world!

apps.name: Baptiste Demo
apps.short_description: Play about 20 minutes of Baptiste for free, a narrative psychological horror game. A grieving boy frees a doll that should never have left its glass cabinet. Take your first steps into the nightmare.

apps.name: beyond.frontiers Demo
apps.short_description: beyond.frontiers is a vast space exploration game. Pilot over 20 ships across 125+ handcrafted and procedural sectors. Customize the game with extensive modding, and dive into fully voiced storylines. Explore, trade, or fight—endless adventures await in the expansive universe of Beyond.Frontiers.

apps.name: Blue Water Builders Demo
apps.short_description: Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management and shipbuilding game set during the golden age of industry. Design, build, launch and manage your own fleet as you take a small shipyard from its humble beginnings to a major force in the world of shipbuilding. So, how far will you take your shipyard?

apps.name: Bowl Big Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Unlock a tech tree. Upgrade pins and balls. Dodge obstacles. Watch numbers skyrocket. Ditch the 10-pin limit and Bowl Big!

apps.name: Broken Drive Demo
apps.short_description: Broken Drive Demo is a first-person psychological horror preview featuring a 6-day atmospheric teaser of the full game. Explore the eerie corridors of an abandoned hospital, identify creeping anomalies, and maintain your sanity to survive all 6 days.

apps.name: Cards n' Varmints Demo
apps.short_description: cute + tough card tactics autobattles

apps.name: Celestial Decks Demo
apps.short_description: Life is brief... But death? That's another story. Celestial is a competitive card game where experience is worth its weight in gold. Weave your tale with beautifully illustrated cards. Uncover powerful synergies to claim victory. Follow the paths of the Penumbra, or match wits against other players.

apps.name: Chat, Should We Head Over There? Demo
Dala and the Cursed Forest Demo
apps.short_description: A Roguelike Deckbuilder with fun card fusion and transformations. Combine different cards to create powerful combos and generate power cells that can be used to unlock special abilities. Collect four identical cells to transform Dala into special forms to take on powerful mythical creatures.

apps.name: Deprived Demo
apps.short_description: You find yourself trapped inside what seems to be an ordinary house. But as soon as you take your first steps, you’ll realize it has been consumed by paranormal anomalies. Caught in an endless loop, your only way forward is to locate and capture these anomalies to progress through the levels.

apps.name: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG Demo
apps.short_description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

apps.name: Dice in Wonderland Demo
apps.short_description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Forge every die yourself and stack chips × mult until the Queen's own scorekeeper gives up counting. A cruel, twisted Wonderland under the Cheshire Cat's watchful grin — one more run, all the way down.

apps.name: Dig to Mole Dorado Demo
apps.short_description: Burrow deep into the earth in this short incremental digging game. Hunt for treasure, upgrade your powers and experience the low-key story of a mole and his dad on a grand adventure.

apps.name: Dispatch Demo
apps.short_description: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

apps.name: Down with the Ship Demo
apps.short_description: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

apps.name: eethCross Demo
apps.short_description: Free sample of eethCross, a colored nonogram (picross) puzzle game. Play 10 built-in puzzles, the daily puzzle, and random grids. The full game adds the editor, Steam Workshop, and the rest of the 110 puzzles.

apps.name: Emberfall Demo
apps.short_description:
Emberfall is the first Roguevania-Survivor: an action-platformer blending roguelite, Metroidvania, and survivor elements.
Navigate the treacherous catacombs of the fallen citadel 'Lemia,' brimming with danger and mystery, and escape within 10 minutes—or face eternal doom.

apps.name: Endless Canvas Demo
apps.short_description: In this game, you will explore an infinitely zoomable canvas. Dive into the world within the painting, solve layers of puzzles, and seek out the secrets hidden deep within the artwork.

apps.name: Erenshor Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the small island of Stowaway's Step that sits just off the coast of Erenshor. The island serves as a prologue to the main game, and features 5-10 hours of content. Encounter battles, complete quests, find magic spells, and work to find a way off the island.

apps.name: Eternity Convergence Demo
apps.short_description: The demo contains a vertical slice of the game allowing the player to progress until the first major story line divides.  A number of the features, such as two player coop, have been disabled for the demo.

apps.name: ExoFlora First Seeds Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of ExoFlora: First Seeds. Play the first two chapters: grow alien plants in an abandoned greenhouse, discover reactions between neighbors, breed your first hybrid and send robot spheres out to find new seeds.

apps.name: Failed Falling Demo
apps.short_description: Plan your falls and learn from failure in a challenging descent along an active volcano! Sail its updrafts with your parachute to move forward, but going up is the opposite of your goal, so don't drift for too long: losing progress will be inevitable, but giving up is always a choice...

apps.name: False God Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into your psyche again and again. What began as a quest to save your sister devolves into a fight for your soul in this story-rich adventure. Unearth forbidden lore, decipher hidden clues, and outwit cosmic entities as you explore a world blending Chinese folk horror with Lovecraftian horror.

apps.name: Far Realm Demo
apps.short_description:
Far Realm — A Narrative 2D Pixel Adventure.
Overworked engineer Lin Zongda enters a bizarre yokai world while trying to save his comatose grandma.

“Wait… Grandma, why are you a phone now?”
Meet quirky yokai, solve bizarre mysteries, and join them on a bittersweet journey home.

apps.name: Farming and Supermarket Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on a relaxing yet challenging journey to manage your own supermarket. Grow organic crops, care for your animals, and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you transform your supermarket into an empire?

apps.name: Fatiao for free
apps.short_description: Fatiao is a plugin-based desktop AI agent. The core plans and orchestrates; voice, knowledge base, search, desktop control, automation and sub-agents are plugins you toggle. Plugins and skills come from the community Workshop — one click to subscribe. One app, a thousand faces. Windows and macOS.

apps.name: Fill The Void Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the power of BEING a black hole. Consume everything. Grow. Morph between a void that swallows the world and a rolling sphere that bounces, dashes, and wall-jumps across themed diorama levels. Inspired by Katamari Damacy.

apps.name: Fleets of Valor Demo
apps.short_description: Fleets of Valor is a single-player WWII naval real-time tactics game. In this free demo, command cruisers and destroyers during the training mission to sink enemy ships. Then defend Pearl Harbor with the 40mm Bofors gun, escort bombers and engage in dogfights.

apps.name: Forgotten Tavern Demo
apps.short_description: Run a tavern simulation set in a hidden Korean mountain village. Gather ingredients through unpredictable weather, discover traditional Korean recipes, and serve mystical Dokkaebi and villagers. Get to know your guests by discovering their favourite dishes and unique preferences.

apps.name: ForMind Demo
apps.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

apps.name: Fred's Idle Garden Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that hangs out on your desktop while you work, study or just chill 🌻

apps.name: Fruit Auto Fighters Demo
apps.short_description: In this auto battler, every fruit on your team is slowly rotting. Draft a squad, arm them with weapons, and compost the spoiled ones into fertilizer for whoever's left. Then send them out to fight teams built by real players.

apps.name: Glintseeker Island Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into mysterious caves with countless treasures to excavate in a mining exploration adventure. Upgrade your gear, fight bosses, uncover secrets and save the island from an ancient threat below!

apps.name: Gnomes Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression, set in ever-expanding, procedurally generated biomes. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde.

apps.name: Golel Demo
apps.short_description: Golel Demo is the first chapter of Golel. Golel is a first person Dungeon Crawler with a full RPG campaign and an optional rogue like mode. Combat is focused on mobility and using the environment to your advantage. Drop a bookshelves on a skeleton? It is possible in Golel.

apps.name: Grace Demo
apps.short_description: Grace is a hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy action-metroidvania. Control two rival characters bound by the same destiny: master responsive combat, traverse an interconnected world, and beware your counterpart—if you cross paths and fall in battle, you must switch sides.

apps.name: GraviSmack Demo
apps.short_description: Bend gravity, skate across impossible surfaces, and smash through swarms in GraviSmack, a movement-driven action roguelite. Build a wild mix of weapons and boons, unlock new characters, and fight solo or with friends.

apps.name: Hacked: The Streamer Demo
apps.short_description: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

apps.name: Headstone Demo
apps.short_description: Try Headstone free: a 3D arcade wave shooter in a moonlit graveyard. As the gravekeeper, hold St. Gloom's churchyard alone against zombies, skeletons, vampires and ghosts, buy a scattergun, and see if you can survive all 25 waves.

apps.name: Heretic's Rapture DEMO
apps.short_description:
Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth.

Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

apps.name: Heroic Musical Chairs Demo
apps.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

apps.name: Island Sort Demo
apps.short_description: Bring order to a messy island, one crate at a time. Island Sort is a relaxing sorting game for solo play, 3-player online co-op or 1v1 races. Try the Bakery, the Fruit Stand and the Workshop in this free demo.

apps.name: Keyframes Demo
apps.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

apps.name: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel Demo
Lapistasia -ラピスタシア- Demo
apps.short_description:
3-min learn, 100-hour addiction!
Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro.
The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless!
Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

apps.name: Leadwerks Game Engine Trial Version
apps.short_description: Leadwerks Game Engine 5 is an all-new update that makes game development easier than ever. Dive into our video tutorials and learn everything you need to bring your ideas to life. Create with ease using our intuitive visual editor and Lua script. Publish your projects with a royalty-free license.

apps.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first ten waves of Leftovers. Five characters, two co-op modes (The Classic Run and Last Fridge Standing), solo, couch or online for up to four players. Everything you earn carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Living Dead Outbreak Demo
apps.short_description: Battle your way through the dense zombie crowds as you struggle to survive! Inspired by classic zombie movies and FPS games from the 90s, the overwhelming combat will keep you on your toes!

apps.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner Demo
apps.short_description:
Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories.

How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?

apps.name: Lyra Mahjong manager Demo
apps.short_description: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.

apps.name: Magickness Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the Dawn of Magick in this open-world MMORPG demo. Create your character, explore Pangea, gather resources, craft equipment, discover Magick, battle enemies, develop your abilities, and experience the foundations of a persistent online world.

apps.name: Manual Teller Machine Demo
apps.short_description:
In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager.
Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise!
Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

apps.name: Medieval Shepherd Demo
apps.short_description: Experience life as a medieval shepherd in this demo. Herd the flock with your loyal dog and protect them from wolves and bandits. Survive through basic crafting and sell your products at the market.

apps.name: MineEngineer Demo
apps.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

apps.name: MobMate WhispTalk – Zero-Cloud Voice Chat Toolkit Demo
My Mates Demo
apps.short_description: Forget about real-life worries and dive into student life: settle into your rented apartment, keep up with your studies, and, of course, make close friends among your new classmates.

apps.name: MycoRelic Demo
apps.short_description: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten powers.

apps.name: Myriad Gambit Demo
apps.short_description: Try a complete run of Myriad Gambit, a single-player auto battler inspired by Chinese mythology. Choose from four heroes, build a seven-slot formation with four tribes and neutral cards, and face minor bosses and a final trial. Easy difficulty, tiers 1–6.

apps.name: Nightbound Demo
apps.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

apps.name: Noclip: Entity Demo
apps.short_description: Escape the Backrooms, or become the thing everyone is escaping from. One player hunts, seven run: lock doors, swing crowbars and talk your way out of trouble (or into it) in a 1v7 asymmetrical horror party with proximity chat, where every level is new and the exit is never where you left it.

apps.name: Nullnest Demo
apps.short_description: Defend the Core in a dark tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

apps.name: Paresis® II Demo
apps.short_description:
Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses.
Survive…if you can.

apps.name: Path of Broken Builds Demo
apps.short_description: The complete first world of Path of Broken Builds: a real-time roguelike where you grow a skill tree while your hero fights on their own. Twenty floors, three mini-bosses, the finale and an endless mode after you win. World 2 is in the full version.

apps.name: Peaceful Days Demo
apps.short_description: Peaceful Days Demo offers tons of fun activities to keep you busy for hours! Take over a cozy local farm in the charming seaside town of Aurora, meet friendly locals, and enjoy your new peaceful life!

apps.name: PERIOD SURVIVAL:Final Trial Demo
apps.short_description:
Heili, The musician who survived the life-or-death variety show "VIAGRA" and won a massive prize,
has once again joined a show where his life on the line!
Want to survive? Then, DANCE!

PERIOD SURVIVAL:Final Trial is a mystery adventure game you find "Varient" participants through dance battle.

apps.name: PETNAROK Demo
apps.short_description: Autobattler animal roguelite inspired by Super Auto Pets & Balatro. Merge animals, apply Fruit & Veggie buffs, and discover powerful synergies.

apps.name: Pixel Gun 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

apps.name: Planet Pilot Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Planet Pilot. Learn to fly over Paris in a guided first flight, take your first jobs, fly through golden Sky Hunt rings and an airshow, then try Dogfights over the Moab canyons: flight school, a boss duel and a Legend battle. Your demo career carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Pro Football Referee Demo
apps.short_description: Pro Football Referee is a football referee simulation game.Start as an unknown grassroots referee and experience the full career of a football official. Officiate matches, make crucial calls, build reputation, and climb the ranks.

apps.name: Project Looking Glass Demo
apps.short_description: 1963. A classified CIA experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

apps.name: Psalm 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Demo version of a first-person psychological horror game in which the elevator is the only safe place. On each floor a new reality. On each floor a new inhabitant. Find him to continue the descent down.

apps.name: Restitched: Wardrobe Demo
apps.short_description: Style and design your own Stuffy! Mix and match cosmetics, decorate unique outfits, and explore community creations in this free preview of Restitched's character customization mode.

apps.name: Retromine Demo
apps.short_description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

apps.name: SCP - Containment Breach Revival Demo
apps.short_description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

apps.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3 - Single Player Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Check out what awaits you in the game and try the Demo version - grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard!

apps.name: Sketchy Fables Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a fully hand-drawn open world full of innocence, until the childlike mind gives way.

apps.name: Spooky Bodies Demo
apps.short_description: Spooky Bodies is a cozy puzzle game with a ghostly twist. Switch between ghost and human by using traps or possessing bodies. Each form offers unique abilities. Combine them cleverly and interact with the world to solve creative, brain-teasing puzzles.

apps.name: Story of the Lost Dot Demo
apps.short_description: Discover the classic tale of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland in a whole new way. A gaming experience where you get to feel what it's like to dive inside a novel as a small dot. Roll left and right, rewind time, and venture deeper through the story as you try to find your way back home.

apps.name: Straw Path Demo
apps.short_description: Two months alone in a mountain shack. A locked-away gun. A silent man forced back into a world that stopped waiting for him. Straw Path is a slow-burn survival horror shooter about what it costs to go back outside and what's already found its way in...

apps.name: Streetdog BMX Demo
apps.short_description: Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams in the demo for Streetdog BMX! Explore the Training map, featuring hidden spots, flowing lines, and a set of tutorial challenges to get you started.

apps.name: Tales of Tonbrook Demo
apps.short_description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid.  When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it!  Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

apps.name: The Adventurer's Guide to Another World Demo
apps.short_description: A delightful action adventure set in a mysterious another world! Defeat enemies in satisfying hack-and-slash combat, and explore dungeons filled with puzzles. Combine unique skills and gear to raise the ultimate adventurer and save the continent!

apps.name: The MachinEGG Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing incremental game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Buy chickens, feed them, sell their eggs, and automate your way to retirement!

apps.name: The Smiling Flesh Demo
apps.short_description: The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where you play as a thief trapped in a decaying gothic mansion. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

apps.name: The Window Across Demo
apps.short_description: Demo: the prologue at the childhood window and the first chapter. A rainy courtyard, the stairwell, a flat where everything is still in its place, and the first shadow puzzle.

apps.name: Tides of Trade: Eastern Horizons Demo
Top of That Thing Called Mountain Demo
apps.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

apps.name: Toxoplasma Demo
apps.short_description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

apps.name: Trees Hate You Demo
apps.short_description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

apps.name: Trizna Demo
apps.short_description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

apps.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo
