apps.short_description: You are a Gold Eater dwarf the size of a rabbit. Mine, slay, loot, and eat gold to grow, coin by coin, into a titan big enough to swallow the sun god who cursed you. A 2D sandbox where your size changes everything, solo or with friends.

apps.name: EDGE-FI
apps.short_description: Don’t rush to figure out what’s going on in a place the world has discarded, where dim neon flickers through the haze. Discover how the devices around you work, and lose yourself in atmospheric music as you bring the city back to life. So, when progress moves on without us, where do we belong?

apps.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
apps.short_description: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

apps.name: EPIBDA
apps.short_description: Iceland, October 1989. For seven nights you keep the light on a remote lighthouse. Out in the fog stands EPIBDA, a thing 120 metres tall. It moves only when no one is looking. Keep the beam on it, guide the ships past the reef, and don't let the lamp run dry.

apps.name: Erevael
apps.short_description: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.

apps.name: Eternal Fracture
apps.short_description: In Eternal Fracture, you play as officer T. A grieving police officer that gets dispatched to the Bayou Mall in Louisiana to reset a known malfunctioning security system. What was supposed to be just another late-night routine sweep turns into dread. You are being watched.

apps.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
apps.short_description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

apps.name: EverDarkly: Beloved
apps.short_description: A top-down 2.5D space roguelite. Salvage the bones of a war nobody talks about. Loot rolls, adrenaline charges with chaos, death sends you back to the Cradle. Your AI companion Luna keeps the silence company. Something out there is waiting for you to get good enough.

apps.name: Everhex
apps.short_description: Build one tower. Hold endless waves. Spend what each wave drops on damage, crit and six weapon mounts firing at once — then bank the run into a 453-node passive tree that carries into the next. A premium incremental tower defence: no ads, no timers, no energy bars.

apps.name: Factory Time
apps.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

apps.name: False God
apps.short_description: Dive into your psyche again and again. What began as a quest to save your sister devolves into a fight for your soul in this story-rich adventure. Unearth forbidden lore, decipher hidden clues, and outwit cosmic entities as you explore a world blending Chinese folk horror with Lovecraftian horror.

apps.name: Final Night At Hotel
apps.short_description: Together, you must investigate the creature haunting the hotel, collect clues, and vote each night for determine the strategy to defeat it. When night falls, your goal is clear: kill or exorcise the creature... Horror game for up to 5 players

apps.name: Find The Gold
apps.short_description: A mountain of sand. Gold hidden somewhere inside. Dig, haul and sell your first loads, then build the machines that take over the hard work. Connect conveyors, power a growing factory and uncover natural gold specimens in a first-person digging and automation game.

apps.name: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
apps.short_description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring over 40 fishing destinations and 260 fish to discover. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

apps.name: Foodgitives
apps.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op arcade game where you're food on the run. Tilt and roll through restaurants where murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Wrestle with your friends for control of the tilt, or master it alone.

apps.name: Fox in a Field
apps.short_description: In this fresh new take on the classic Minesweeper, cross the field one step at a time. Find your babies on the way to the exit. Move around obstacles and find hidden objects in the field too! If you ever enjoyed mine sweeper you will love my game. Choose quick play or Quest through 100 levels

apps.name: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
apps.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

apps.name: FreeSurf
apps.short_description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

apps.name: Fruit Auto Fighters
apps.short_description: In this auto battler, every fruit on your team is slowly rotting. Draft a squad, arm them with weapons, and compost the spoiled ones into fertilizer for whoever's left. Then send them out to fight teams built by real players.

apps.name: GAY IT LOUD
apps.short_description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

apps.name: Gembound
apps.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

apps.name: Get On Board!
apps.short_description: Run a boat tour with your crew! Set sail with passengers, keep the wheel steady, and navigate rough waters without mixing up orders. Complete the voyage without capsizing and become Amalfi's top tour agency.

apps.name: Gingar Ail Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of a witch disguised as a student for one semester. In this heart-stealing visual novel RPG, build relationships with seven unique characters and decide whose heart you’ll claim… or who might just steal yours.

apps.name: Greenfire
apps.short_description: Greenfire is a turn-based 3D tank artillery game where every shot reshapes the battlefield. Master wild weapons, trigger chain reactions, outsmart AI rivals, and take on a punishing 20-round campaign—or experiment freely in the shooting range.

apps.name: Grimmarch
apps.short_description: A dark folk-horror card RPG. Walk a story campaign across a dying borderland, make hard choices for the people who stayed, and win card battles by outguessing enemies who play at the same moment you do. Grow your hero with new cards, talents and levels. Play solo or with up to four friends.

apps.name: Grindset T.V.
apps.short_description: Grindset T.V. is an open world speedrunning first person platformer for the freaks. God is dead, and Heaven has gone corporate. You’re a gig worker hivemind engineered for package delivery. Welcome to Heaven. Watch your step.

apps.name: Guild Master
apps.short_description: An old-school RPG where you run the whole guild solo or with friends. Gather, craft, farm, fight, loot and explore with a growing crew. Switch heroes while the others keep working, turn shared supplies into better gear, and prepare your adventurers to face a deadly fire-breathing dragon.

apps.name: Hack The Stars
apps.short_description: A tactical cyberpunk MMO where you infiltrate networks through real-time hex-grid combat, managing CPU, Heat, and Bandwidth. No classes. No levels. Progression through hardware limits. Hack megacorps, crash economies, and uncover your erased past across a persistent galaxy.

apps.name: Halve
apps.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

apps.name: Hamster Time
apps.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

apps.name: Hantu and Hunted
apps.short_description: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

apps.name: Hayloop
apps.short_description: A cozy farming and ranching sim where you grow a small plot into a thriving agricultural business. Plant and tend crops, raise animals, keep bees, process your harvest into valuable goods, open your shop, and automate your farm as it grows, all on your way to breeding prized horses.

apps.name: Heretic's Fork - RAPTURE
apps.short_description:
Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth.

Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

apps.name: Hokm: Card Game of Kings
apps.short_description: Hokm is Iran's classic trick-taking card game for four players in two partnerships, painted like the coffeehouse pictures of the Shahnameh. Call the trump, follow suit, take seven tricks. Play online, on your own network with friends, or alone against the bots.

apps.name: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
apps.short_description:
Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling.
In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

apps.name: How They Built the Pyramids
apps.short_description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

apps.name: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
apps.short_description: A classic turn-based JRPG set in five rival nations inspired by Hyogo, Japan (home of Kobe). Guide a hesitant prince through a land where every nation has its own idea of justice, explore far and wide, and find your way to the true ending. Fully playable in English.

apps.name: Incremental Magic
apps.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

apps.name: Indeterminate
apps.short_description: A scare-your-friends asymmetrical horror game where one of you is the indeterminate. Survivors gather evidence to work out what it is and banish it with a ritual, while the indeterminate turns anomalies, traps and jump scares against them, or catches them off guard and kills them.

apps.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together
apps.short_description: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together is an online cooperative jigsaw puzzle game featuring the true einstein tile. Up to 8 players can piece together a single puzzle side by side.

apps.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles3
apps.short_description: Infinite Einstein Tiles3 is a casual puzzle game based on the "true einstein tile" discovered by David Smith and his colleagues.

apps.name: INKLINE: Erased Lines
apps.short_description: Your desktop is more than a screen — a world waiting to be drawn. Sketch bridges, raise walls and set traps with your mouse in this hand-drawn action platformer. Battle ink-born monsters, explore chapters and face bosses as an adventure comes alive above your taskbar.

apps.name: Inkwell Cove
apps.short_description: Explore a vibrant ocean paradise, raise and customize adorable Octos, discover hidden treasures, and compete in races, battles, and minigames as you build the ultimate underwater pet collection.

apps.name: Iron Dogs
apps.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

apps.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles
apps.short_description: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles is a real-time strategy game about conquering medieval islands. Grow your kingdom, raise armies, capture regions, and command entire forces. Plan your expansion, reinforce key positions, and choose the right moment to strike.

apps.name: Island Sort
apps.short_description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

apps.name: Isle Goblin
apps.short_description: Build, explore, fight and rescue your goblin family from the human invaders in a sandbox survival adventure game. Play solo or with up to 7 friends as you rebuild your town, craft powerful gear, explore dungeons, mine rare resources, salvage human treasure, and befriend your goblin neighbours

apps.name: Jinx It
apps.short_description: Jinx It is a roguelike dicebuilder where every die has a trick. Arrange rolls into Straights and Sets, reshape your dice at the Forge, stack Lucky Charms, and face those who lost everything to Jinx, the Unlucky One, as you turn your bad luck into a broken build.

apps.name: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979
apps.short_description: The world ended and the madness began. As Max, survive a brutal, radioactive wasteland to save your kidnapped daughter from a ruthless gang. Fight radiation, explore a dangerous open world in 1st/3rd person, and make choices that shape your destiny in this dark RPG survival.

apps.name: K.H.L.E.E
apps.short_description: Retro roguelike deckbuilder meets corporate dystopia. In 1982, AGI runs the world, you're just a cog. Log into your K.H.L.E.E. terminal, arrange tiles to meet shifting quotas, and survive the week. Fail once - your profile is wiped. Endless candidates are waiting.

apps.name: KILLNETIC
apps.short_description: KILLNETIC is a multiplayer-only movement shooter. Slide, dash, wall run and slam around gothic steampunk arenas, earn weapon ultimates, and hear nearby players over proximity chat.

apps.name: Let Me Die
apps.short_description: You're trapped by a monster! Hit it, collect gems and coins, buy upgrades, watch numbers go up. Until you're strong enough to escape.

apps.name: LightSup!
apps.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

apps.name: LINETAIN
apps.short_description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

apps.name: Linkominoes
apps.short_description: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game where overlapping squares form connected structures. Unwind with the satisfaction of placing pieces and building patterns, or take on unique challenges that put spatial planning and strategy to the test.

apps.name: Livingston County
apps.short_description: The dead fill the streets of Howell, Michigan. Search houses for food, haul supplies home, and board up before dark. Build a base and keep a few people alive in an isometric zombie survival sandbox.

apps.name: LockDown Dom
apps.short_description: A visual novel where you can either dominate or submit to the love interests.

apps.name: Lost Soul
apps.short_description: A nameless skeleton awakens in a graveyard. To recover lost memories and uncover the truth, it embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: LouLan
apps.short_description: Loulan Kingdom blends survival city-building with real-time strategy. As the ruler of Loulan, build your city in a procedurally generated desert oasis, prosper through trade along the Silk Road, and fight with all you have to defend your kingdom until the very end.

apps.name: Love, in Debt!?
apps.short_description: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
developers: 华东理工大学创客空间

apps.name: Lowlands Conquest
apps.short_description: The orc and undead camps are spreading across your land, threatening to overrun everything in their path. As their numbers grow, so does their power. It’s up to you to lead the charge and wipe them out before it's too late.

apps.name: Marrowlight
apps.short_description: Seven women are chained beneath the world, holding an apocalypse down. You are the Warden sworn to execute them when they fail. Free them instead. A horde-survival roguelite where every character you unlock is someone you were sent to kill.

apps.name: Math Defense Protocol
apps.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

apps.name: Monster Forest
apps.short_description: The ancient forest has been corrupted by void energy into a fleshy spawning ground of mutated beasts. Choose two exiles from different factions to form a pact, and wield two distinct card builds to fight your way out of the suffocating woodland depths!

apps.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
apps.short_description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

apps.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
apps.short_description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

apps.name: MURINO: The Fog Is Coming
apps.short_description:
You are a courier in endless Murino.
Deliver orders, survive the fog, descend into the sewers, and decide who you will serve in a city where reality itself has long since cracked.

apps.name: Myriad Auction
apps.short_description: Blind-bid an entire warehouse in a roguelike auction. Spend resources to uncover clues about what is really inside, sharpen the appraiser's estimate, then make the one call that matters: bid or pass? Win the lot, then crack it open item by item to find out whether you struck gold or got fleeced.

apps.name: Mystic 6
apps.short_description: A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. Along your journey, weapons, potions, skills, runes, and much more will shape every run.

apps.name: NEO DRONE: REVERSE
apps.short_description: NEO DRONE: REVERSE is a sci-fi arcade game where you reverse direction, dodge obstacles, and use shields to survive. Avoid moving and blinking hazards, beat your high score, and compete on the online leaderboard. The world moves forward. You move backward.

apps.name: Neural Repair
apps.short_description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

apps.name: NEVER LOOK BACK
apps.short_description:
Descend the infinite office staircase. The Darkness follows you. Squeeze the rubber duck to not be afraid. And never look back.
Psychological horror in a dreamcore aesthetic

apps.name: New World Trading Company
apps.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

apps.name: NII-058
apps.short_description: Winter, the nineties. You climb onto the roof of a shut-down research institute to strip its copper, and the rusted roof gives way. The doors are welded, the windows bricked up. Something walks in the dark. Find a way out before it finds you.

apps.name: Nobody: Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description:
《Nobody: Three Kingdoms 》 is a card-driven roguelike set in the twilight of the Han dynasty. You open your eyes as a foot soldier no one will ever name. You arrive carrying the knowledge of an entire modern world, and what it buys you on day one is nothing. 
So before anything else — stay alive.

apps.name: Noclip: Entity
apps.short_description: Escape the Backrooms, or become the thing everyone is escaping from. One player hunts, seven run: lock doors, swing crowbars and talk your way out of trouble (or into it) in a 1v7 asymmetrical horror party with proximity chat, where every level is new and the exit is never where you left it.

apps.name: Nuclear Reactor Simulator 3D
apps.short_description: Step inside a nuclear power station in a first-person industrial simulation. Explore the facility, use specialist tools, inspect equipment and interact with the machinery of a complex power plant. More systems and gameplay are in development.

apps.name: Operation Pay-per-Love
apps.short_description: An adult, choice-driven visual novel set in Tokyo’s nightlife. Follow one of three women, investigate an exploitative industry, and decide whether your money and attention will protect her freedom—or purchase a deeper dependency.

apps.name: Orbital Abyss: Cipher Division
apps.short_description: Decipher interstellar transmissions encoded via substitution ciphers aboard Eremite Station. In this choice driven narrative, uncover secrets from planetary factions while conversing with crewmates to reveal their stories and troubles. The ripples of your choices may be felt throughout the galaxy.

apps.name: Paid Parking Simulator
apps.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

apps.name: Peexel Casino
apps.short_description:
Peexel Casino is an MMO set in the Las Vegas universe.

Hit up the strip with your friends, raid giant casino bosses for loot, or watch your little guy gamble in the corner of your desktop while you work!

In Peexel Casino, there are no rules! (local laws still apply)

apps.name: Pheles Rebirth
apps.short_description: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

apps.name: Pheromone Onsen: How a Loser Got Laid Nonstop Thanks to a Secret Hot Spring
apps.short_description: A linear adult visual novel about a hopeless virgin who discovers a secret hot spring that gives him irresistible pheromones. Enjoy four fully voiced heroines, animated adult scenes, and an escalating hot spring harem—with no routes or complicated choices.

apps.name: Picnic In The Zone
apps.short_description: Picnic In The Zone tells a story about survival in the Zone. A vast, desolate place filled with dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and strange mutated entities. Unveil your epic journey through the Zone as you hopelessly try to find your lost family.

apps.name: Pistol Cat
apps.short_description: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

apps.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
apps.short_description: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature — listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

apps.name: Please, Come Inside
apps.short_description: Horny apocalypse is here. Run the last tavern where seductive succubi hide among innocent beauties. Inspect guests intimately to unmask demons before they drain you dry! A dark fantasy survival sim.

apps.name: Please, Take The Phone
apps.short_description: Welcome to Jiabao Tower Property Management.The night shift has begun. Your job is simple: answer calls, check the manual, and fill out the forms. When the night feels slow, watch some TV—though the programs may seem strange.Remember: serve every resident well. Jiabao Tower is our home forever.

apps.name: Pocket TD
apps.short_description: A tower defense game on a map that grows as you play. Build from 12 towers, survive five biomes and their bosses, and pick perks that change each run.

apps.name: Poly Speed
apps.short_description: Poly Speed is a Low Poly racing game with an open world. You can play races against your friends or AI's. You can try to get the World Record in one of the races. Or build your own races to play with your friends.

apps.name: Prison Chef Simulator
apps.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

apps.name: Projekt Z: Beyond Order
apps.short_description: Battle the undead in this thrilling First-Person Zombie Shooter with robust character progression and weapon customization. Set around World War II, take on fast-paced missions as one of four survivors, each with their own unique abilities and role in Co-Op.

apps.name: PURLOIN
apps.short_description: PURLOIN! Steal in darkness to build in light. Cozy co-op horror.

apps.name: PWC Simulator
apps.short_description: PWC Simulator is a personal watercraft simulator with singleplayer practice, freestyle, online racing, and mod support.

apps.name: Quarter Note Cafe
apps.short_description: Act as Charithy, serving coffee to cultists, instruments and the regular passerby from your coffee shop in a city filled with all sorts of weird, kind and potentially dangerous people.

apps.name: Raceway Sparks
apps.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

apps.name: Ragnarok - Rise of the Nine Realms
apps.short_description: Build a Viking settlement, explore the Nine Realms and bargain with the gods. Rebuild from a camp in each new world, then carry your discoveries and permanent legacy through Ragnarök into another age. An offline single-player incremental game of resources, expeditions and rebirth.

apps.name: Railway End
apps.short_description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

apps.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
apps.short_description: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

apps.name: RaviWar 1 : A Perfect Sonday
apps.short_description: A free first-person adventure of puzzles and precarious jumps. It is 2077. The world lives inside Takarek, a tower of 17,769 floors, and Consensus has decided what everyone in it thinks for forty years. You are twenty, new to the job of deprecating data. Tonight you keep one file to save the world.

apps.name: Red Ledger
apps.short_description: Four departments. One sealed warehouse. Submit your secret budget, claim the assets, and hope the paperwork survives inspection. Red Ledger is a short 4-player PvP bluffing game with bot-filled seats.

apps.name: Reef Royale
apps.short_description: A fast-paced battle royale for fish. Pick one of 30 fish, eat to grow, and bump everyone else out of a shrinking reef. Sharks, nets and whirlpools join in. Last fish wins.

apps.name: Rexaura
apps.short_description: Rexaura is a modification for Valve's Portal containing a new 20-chamber campaign centered around high energy pellets and many new testing elements. It is recommended for players who are familiar with Portal but want an extra challenge.

apps.name: RiftForged
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy multiplayer action RPG. Hunt monsters across deformable terrain, harvest their parts, and craft gear from what you kill. Dig a pit, use the pit. The physics hold it, and the monsters navigate around it. The world holds every mark you leave.

apps.name: Riftscourge
apps.short_description: Protect the land from the invading Demon Army in this action-packed couch co-op, hack n' slash with a rogue-like progression system.

apps.name: Rivergrain Vale
apps.short_description: You bought an old farm to escape the noise of the city — but it's not that simple. The place is in ruins, and the workers have walked out. Roll up your sleeves, win them back one by one, and learn the farming life alongside your charming farmhands.

apps.name: Rogue Dungeon 2
apps.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

apps.name: Roll N' Rage
apps.short_description: A difficult physics-based platforming game about a golf ball's journey home. Roll, fall, rage, repeat... or quit. It's up to you.

apps.name: Romance of Fangs: Part 1
apps.short_description: Humans and vampires must learn to coexist in harmony... could one vampire save them all? Help Brynn find true romance, navigate ancient traditions, and save the city in this choice-driven narrative adventure.

apps.name: Roots and Runes
apps.short_description: Roots & Runes is an RPG that combines a cozy homesteading atmosphere with a touch of adventure. In this game, you can build, decorate, farm, craft, fish and sell, or you can explore the world in engaging adventures, learn magic and take it home with you.

apps.name: rov
apps.short_description: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!

apps.name: Sagventyr
apps.short_description: This action game incorporates elements unique to the medium—such as the spirit of exploration as you venture into the unknown, the tension of weighing the risks and rewards of combat, and the exhilaration of acquiring rare, hard-to-find items.

apps.name: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
apps.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

apps.name: SCP - Containment Breach Revival
apps.short_description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

apps.name: SCRAP CROWN
apps.short_description: Rip their weapons off. Bolt them on. Take the crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler where you choose fights for the parts you can salvage. Build a ridiculous scrap squad, set up powerful combos, and watch your plan play out.

apps.name: Sea of Pirates
apps.short_description: Command your own ship in a shared open sea. Hunt sea monsters and admirals, sink rival captains, conquer islands with your guild and sail into new Battle Pass seasons and seasonal events.

apps.name: Sea of Remnants
apps.short_description: Sea of Remnants is a visually rich ocean adventure RPG. As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make.

apps.name: Shawarma Karma
apps.short_description: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?

apps.name: Sheepscape
apps.short_description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

apps.name: SHORE
apps.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

apps.name: Sigma Survivor
apps.short_description: Sigma Survivor is a roguelike type game. Lead your hero and survive the whole round while enemies of every kind cross your path. Grab power-ups, take risks, play MINIGAMES, upgrade your character, and come back stronger with every run!

apps.name: Simutales
apps.short_description: An open-world life sim! ✦ ݁˖ Build your dream town, reveal the mysteries of your neighbours, and live your best (or worst) life.

apps.name: Sinful Survivors
apps.short_description: A Vampire Survivors-style survival action game. 🎮 Includes 30+ voiced 🗣️ and animated ✨ scenes! 💦 😈Three sinful heroines work hard to survive!🔥Command the seductive Succubus 💋, the motherly Slime 🟢, and the devout Priestess🙏as they battle massive armies surging in from all directions! ⚔️

apps.name: SketchBrawl
apps.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

apps.name: SkullWar:ProvingGrounds
apps.short_description: SkullWar: Proving Grounds is a cold sci-fi tactical strategy game. Control humanoid war machines known as "Skulls" in turn-based hex-grid ranged combat. Act 2 out of 3 actions (Move, Attack, or Function) per turn, with full enemy visibility. Victory lies in resource planning and squad synergy.

apps.name: SLAPPED SILLY
apps.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

apps.name: Slay the Tire
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on two wheels. Ride four outlaws down the world's great roads, from Monument Valley to the Tokaido, the Scottish Highlands and the pyramids of Giza, and fight every car, truck and creature that wants you off the road, one card at a time.

apps.name: SLENDYJAN
apps.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

apps.name: Slime Splitter
apps.short_description: A pixel art incremental game about popping slimes. Sweep your jelly ring across the arena and split every slime into smaller pieces until the screen overflows, then spend the jelly on a huge skill tree and card deck to push past 15 bosses and into endless mode.

apps.name: Snack Attack
apps.short_description:
Something's wrong on aisle 5. The products have woken up. The expiry date is close. Nobody's getting out clean.
Snack Attack is a fast, chaotic party game for you and your friends, grab what you can, before someone grabs you.

apps.name: Solbreak Skirmish
apps.short_description: Solbreak Skirmish is a fast-paced tactical 1v1 battle with RTS-like mechanics. Control your units, each with a unique ability, to help turn the tide of battle in your favor! With multiple win conditions, there's plenty of room for skill expression and creativity to take down your opponent.

apps.name: Solmallow
apps.short_description: A cozy storybook adventure on islands of living felt. Wake beside a giant needle, stitch torn islands back together, gather and forge tools with friendly masters, calm grumpy Sprouts and find out who unravelled the world — and why.

apps.name: SOMIA
apps.short_description: Somia is a psychological horror game in which you follow a young woman who discovers she is trapped in a loop after finding a cursed doll.

apps.name: Soup N' Shots
apps.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world, restore a forgotten farm with your friends. By day, grow crops, explore the wasteland, and uncover its secrets. By night, defend it from dark creatures with live music, a powerful arsenal, and revitalizing soup. Can you survive until dawn?

apps.name: Space Builder Idle
apps.short_description: Start with a small furnace and build your space base, one module at a time. Hire workers, automate production, build an Artificial Sun and assemble your own ship. Use Prestige to start again with permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Spreadsheet Tower Defense
apps.short_description: Spreadsheet TD is a tower defense game set in a spreadsheet. Build a maze of formula towers, then invest in stronger defenses or save for the next round. Draft new tower cards as you play and research more options for future runs. No Excel required.

apps.name: STARFADE
apps.short_description: Command fleets across whole star systems in real time. Hold the warp gates, cut the enemy's supply lines, launch your carriers' wings and tear open a rift to jump a titan behind their lines. Three factions, three story campaigns, and wars from 1v1 duels to sector-wide conquest.

apps.name: STARFADE: Sortie
apps.short_description: Strap into a Lancer frigate in the middle of a war between fleets. Launch off a 900 m supercarrier, lock targets with a glance, break an Edict's lance before it fires and cripple a 7 km worldship. A VR space combat game you can also play on a flat screen.

apps.name: Stash Mayhem
apps.short_description: Run a medieval-fantasy warehouse in this roguelike for 1 to 4 players online. Sort the goods your way while it's calm, survive the rush of impatient customers and upgrade it every night. The only map is in your head. Know where everything is, or just embrace the mayhem.

apps.name: StickType
apps.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

apps.name: Stingray Sanctuary
apps.short_description: Stingray Sanctuary is a cozy idle management game. Raise stingrays in real time, then stack creatures, plants, and curios into systems that earn and collect money for you. Start small, get rich, and let the island run while you're away, or keep it docked on your desktop as you work.

apps.name: Subgloom
apps.short_description: A Metroidvania with roguelike elements where you explore an underground world and the terrain is destructible. Buy powerful guns to kill enemies, drones to fly around, bombs to destroy terrain, and explore hidden rooms.

apps.name: Suns Unknown
apps.short_description: After a failed test of an experimental warp drive, a lone survivor is stranded in an unknown star system. Keep your damaged ship running, recruit a crew, explore alien worlds, and find a way back home.

apps.name: SUSPECIES
apps.short_description: SUSPECIES is a multiplayer hide-and-seek party game for up to 12 players where aliens sculpt and paint themselves to blend into crowds. Hide from the friend hunting you, or take the stage in the SUSPECIES Show and sculpt against your friends or with your team. Don't be sus.

apps.name: Swarmhold
apps.short_description: A base-building action roguelite where the swarm never lets up. Drop into new terrain every run. Gather resources, build your defenses, draft upgrades mid-run, and fight alongside your base to hold the line. Solo or up to 4-player co-op.

apps.name: Swimcraft: Fishing Simulator
apps.short_description: Turn your favourite swims into virtual fishing venues in a cozy angling sim grounded in real watercraft. Snap any water, stock it with fish, tie authentic rigs, read the swim, and land the specimen of a lifetime. Your swim, crafted.

apps.name: Syberia The World Before - Prologue
apps.short_description: Discover the prologue of the next instalment of Syberia: The World Before, which returns to the origins of the Syberia saga.

apps.name: Take or Tear
apps.short_description: Smash boxes. Keep the big prize in play! Contestants, will you take the check or tear it up and push your luck? Add traits to boxes and checks to profit from either choice. Face surprises and deals under my watchful eye. Build your prize pool and aim for a million in prize money!

apps.name: Tales of Soravos: Ashen Company
apps.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG inspired by tabletop games, with deep character customization, dynamic tile-based combat, reactive AI, and a branching narrative shaped by your choices. Create your free company and lead them through a world on the brink of war.

apps.name: Tales of Tonbrook
apps.short_description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid.  When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it!  Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

apps.name: Tarzan VR
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Jungle!  Journey through the fantastic lands of Tarzan in a 3-part adventure created especially for virtual reality. Swing, swim, climb and fight your way across savage lands where the only limits are your own imagination.

apps.name: The Aether Project TD
apps.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

apps.name: The Bitter End
apps.short_description: A sapphic narrative mystery and life sim. Manage your days aboard a liminal ship, navigating relationships both tense and tender. Fall in love, or bring your companions together. Join the crew, investigate your past, and find a way home.

apps.name: THE BOY'S WORD
apps.short_description: “The Boy's Word” is a visual novel about growing up in a Moscow suburb in the 2000s. Lena, 16, is pulled into the local courtyard crew, where friendship, first love and family secrets come at a price. 10 characters, 5 endings — your choices decide everything.

apps.name: The Iconoclast
apps.short_description: A sci-fi turn-based RPG and a homage to the great RPGs of the past, featuring an innovative battle system where you can fight with up to 6 of your party members at once. Plus several fully 3D animated PS1-style FMV cutscenes!

apps.name: The Last Gate
apps.short_description: Choose your heroine and fight through a world being erased. A dark fantasy action roguelite for 1-4 players: build your power with upgrade cards, push through chained rifts in Dive, or face growing hordes with automatic attacks in Survival.

apps.name: The Last Levee
apps.short_description: Raiders want your crew's dig, and they don't need to take it. They just need to break the dam. Hold the line in this first-person tower defense: build and power turrets, patch the gates under fire, and pump out the flood before the pit goes under.

apps.name: The Lootlands
apps.short_description: What if Path of Exile played itself? Build your hero, automate the grind, and collect god-tier loot. Even while you sleep.

apps.name: The Witch’s Errand
apps.short_description: A cozy hidden object adventure about Myrta, a kind but absent-minded witch, and her new assistant. Explore magical locations, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and save the Whispering Forest.

apps.name: Theathre of Maps
apps.short_description: Theatre of Maps is a virtual tabletop for running and playing RPG adventures. Hosted completely via Steam without servers, port-forwarding or subscriptions. Bring any map of VTT export and link multi-level worlds with dynamic fog of war, line of sight, turn based combat, shared journals & more!

apps.name: Toon Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive seven rooms of the Night Parade. Pick 1 of 12 hand-drawn heroes, stack wild upgrades, drink the Elixir of Ascension to unleash every power at once, and break the bosses that guard each door. A cartoon survivors roguelite where the horde arrives in formation.

apps.name: TOP DOG TEXAS
apps.short_description: TOP DOG TEXAS is a dueling simulator for 1–5 players. To become the top dog of the neighborhood, stake your companions’ lives and fight with the cards you draw. On these streets, the nerve to bet matters just as much as your combat skills.

apps.name: Touhou Chess
apps.short_description: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.

apps.name: Tower Hero Survival
apps.short_description: A tower-defense roguelite with automatic attacks. Choose from 60 towers and combine 95 weapons with 100 upgrades. Survive 30 waves or challenge other players online. Every run brings a new build. Whose tower will stand the longest?

apps.name: Town Hall
apps.short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

apps.name: TURF FIGHT
apps.short_description: Command specials. Command throws. In a beat 'em up.

apps.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
apps.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

apps.name: Velistra: Failed State
apps.short_description: A repair sim set in Velistra, a small Balkan country, from the fall of the Eastern Bloc to the early 2000s. Take apart radios, tape decks and TVs, clean them, replace parts or make your own from junk. Some of what comes in is stolen. Some of it has something inside that shouldn't be there.

apps.name: Vesper Vector
apps.short_description: Blast through space and fight on the ground in Vesper Vector, a sci-fi arcade shooter. Dodge projectiles, battle bosses, and upgrade your ship and equipment. Play solo offline or team up with a friend in online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Void In The Darkness
apps.short_description: Here the enemy doesn't just fight — the enemy writes the rules. Mid-battle, the very laws of war are rewritten, and what was your advantage a moment ago becomes a trap. Summon your army, choose its ground, and turn those rules against the one who wrote them.

apps.name: Wail of Despair
apps.short_description: A lonely girl left unaccompanied is followed into the colorful tunnels of her local fast food play place.

apps.name: Wait, They Can Climb?!
apps.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

apps.name: Walk It Off
apps.short_description: Build a wobbly robot for your friend. Then they have to walk it. A physics party game for 1-4 players: stumble across factory courses, dodge stamping presses, shoot switches with your plasma popper, and drop junk in their way from your drone. Nothing is random. Every fall is somebody's fault.

apps.name: Warehouse Bots
apps.short_description: Control warehouse robot traffic with road signs and configurable traffic lights. Manage orders, build and expand your warehouse, and organize storage to keep deliveries moving. Solve traffic jams, upgrade equipment, and grow your operation through the campaign or in sandbox mode.

apps.name: What Acts up
apps.short_description: What Acts up is a psychological realism narrative adventure about social anxiety. Make choices, act under time pressure, and interact with shifting windows as Lin Mo’s fear and self-doubt invade the desktop. Some choices cannot be made, and some words simply refuse to come out.

apps.name: Wheel Make It
apps.short_description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

apps.name: Whispers Of The Shadow
apps.short_description: After a report comes in about Detective Grace Lawson’s missing stepsister, Amy, two officers head to an abandoned house. When Grace arrives, she finds one of them dead and suddenly becomes trapped inside. But something else is waiting for her.

apps.name: Wicknick
apps.short_description: A co-op heist for 1-4 thieves, online or on one screen. Break into Lowlight's vaults by the light of one lantern: hang it on the light-lock to crack the cage, carry the chest out two by two, then hold the lift while the alarm wakes the dark.

apps.name: World of Two Worlds
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric journey between worlds ✨ Having lost your memory, you set out on a path of self-discovery: transform into animals, explore philosophical parables, and seek a legendary artifact capable of bestowing true enlightenment and revealing every facet of the universe 🌿

apps.name: Zarya
apps.short_description: Zarya - a narrative simulator of a rural driver in a post-Soviet style. Deliver packages along country roads, assist the villagers, earn money, collect classic cars, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the homeland.

apps.name: Zombie BBQ House
apps.short_description: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

apps.name: Zoollision
apps.short_description: Pick your angle. Line up the shot. Then watch a single bounce turn the whole match around. Zoollision is a zoo-themed party game where animal balls collide, race, and compete in team minigames. Bring your friends and see where the next unexpected hit takes you.

apps.name: [AFANTASIA]
apps.short_description: Guided by a mysterious voice called “Intrusion,” play as a boy who wakes with no memories and explore a strange yet beautiful town in search of fragments of his lost past. Uncover who you are, and decide who you will become, before your identity vanishes entirely.

apps.name: めろんぱんさばいば～
apps.short_description: Fight slime hordes and heal with melon bread in this roguelite survival action game. Combine weapons, magic, and cards with auto-attacks and unique character skills to survive. Choose from 20 characters and brave stage hazards, from encroaching lava to slippery ice!

apps.name: ガロゥズストライフ
apps.short_description: 『ガロゥズストライフ』は、人間が異形の怪物に変わる事件の最中、超常の力を得た主人公の少年ガロゥと少女ハイマを中心に描くダークファンタジーRPGです。バトルやイベントシーンでは、鮮やかなドット絵のキャラクター達が賑やかに動きます。仲間を集め「ルラガルド」へ旅立ちましょう。

apps.name: 九幽卷
apps.short_description: An ink-wash roguelike deckbuilder with five modes: a 20-floor run, a story mode, Challenge, a Daily Arena and the brand-new Duel, where both sides plan three moves in secret and guess where the other will play. Your enemies play cards too. Five heroes, 454 cards to build with.

apps.name: 僕の彼女とヤッてみる?
apps.short_description: Convince your girlfriend to bang your buddy in this NTR simulator! Will Akitoshi be able to get his girlfriend Minatsu hooked on his peculiar kink?

apps.name: 少牌マイティ
apps.short_description:
Still playing mahjong with 13 tiles?
Mighty Mahjong is a next-gen twist where you start one tile short — and that missing tile becomes a wild card! Outsmart opponents with bold strategy and sharp reads. Anime-style online battles, special rules, team modes, and fast-paced matches. Free to play!

apps.name: 时光餐厅
apps.short_description: 《时光餐厅》是一款轻松休闲的餐厅经营游戏。你将从一家小餐馆开始，安排厨师做菜、服务员上菜，接待不断到来的顾客。随着生意越来越好，你可以扩展餐厅规模、解锁更多菜品，让自己的餐厅变得越来越热闹。

apps.name: 灵田修仙：炼丹模拟器
apps.short_description: **Cultivation: Alchemy Simulator** blends Chinese fantasy, incremental growth, management, and light roguelite elements. Grow spiritual herbs, refine pills, recover lost formulas, cultivate techniques, befriend fellow cultivators, and ascend toward immortality.

apps.name: 熊猫武者：余烬
apps.short_description: Pandrior emberwake is a  action game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. In a world where humanity is extinct, face off against mutated creatures and mechanical legions. Amidst the cold, steel slaughter, carve a path to survival in this ruined world.
developers: 杭州短尾猴视觉科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州短尾猴视觉科技有限公司

apps.name: 猫咪小窝
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop cat companion. Decorate a little home, prepare meals, tidy the litter box, and pause for a pet. Collect daily fur drops to unlock furniture and room colors, then watch your cat wander between the rooms you create.

apps.name: 猫猫放置
apps.short_description: MiaoMiao Idle is a healing-style cat-themed idle game. In the peaceful "Cat Village", you live alongside adorable cats — gathering, fishing, farming, mining, raising cats, building, and crafting equipment, enjoying a laid-back countryside cat life.

apps.name: 発情エクスタシー
apps.short_description: In this game, you'll give massages to girls currently in heat. As a staff member at a massage parlor, your goal is to fulfill the requests of visiting girls and leave them thoroughly satisfied. Four unique characters are eagerly waiting for your touch!

apps.name: 花札ノ巫孤 / Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda
apps.short_description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

apps.name: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
apps.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

apps.name: 财富大爆炸
apps.short_description: 财富大爆炸是一款以财富积累为核心的数值成长类游戏。你需要通过解锁与升级资产、选择策略、掌握宇宙、创世模拟等机制不断财富突破上限，体验从起步到指数级膨胀的爽感。适合喜欢放置、点击与长期养成的玩家。

apps.name: 超魔球！ホームランダービー
apps.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

apps.name: 逍遥游
apps.short_description: 《逍遥游》是一款东方玄幻题材的经典回合制线上游戏。五大门派、召唤兽养成、装备打造、拍卖行自由交易，缉拿强盗、捉拿恶鬼、封印妖王、挑战星君——老回合制的味道都在。支持一人五开，挂机不肝，每天两小时，玩得自在。

apps.name: 魔塔
apps.short_description: Explore two classic pixel-art towers where every step matters. Plan routes, collect keys and weigh battle costs across the 21-floor and 50-floor adventures. Choose visual themes and character appearances, with local saves. In-game text: Simplified Chinese.

apps.name: Matsuro Palette Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This is a soundtrack that compiles the BGM of "Matsuro Palette".

apps.name: Moonlighter (Original Soundtrack)
apps.short_description: All tracks mastered and mixed for the digital version of the album, delivered in various formats ( 320kbps .MP3, .WAV, .FLAC). Along with the music, you’ll receive multiple digital goods, that can be used to customize your computer or smartphone.

apps.name: StickType Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Songs from StickType

apps.name: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Drum and Bass, Breakcore and Garage sound for breaking your neck.

apps.name: The Count Lucanor Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Marvel in the delightfully creepy music of Chiptune Bach and take the soundscape of the castle out of The Count Lucanor and into your Steam Library, with The Count Lucanor Soundtrack!

apps.name: World of Goo Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The World of Goo Original Soundtrack with music by Kyle Gabler in MP3 and FLAC formats.

apps.name: 局外人 L'Etranger - Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: 局外人 L'Etranger - Original Soundtrack
